request.style: English, conscious roots reggae, militant steppers drum beat, dub bass, echoing guitar, a prophetic male voice, a call to justice, minor key, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I hate, I despise your feasts
I take no delight in your solemn assemblies
Though you offer me your offerings
I will not accept them

[Verse]
Take away from me the noise of your songs
To the melody of your harps I will not listen
Your festivals are empty
When the poor cry out at your gate

[Chorus]
But let justice roll down like waters
And righteousness like an ever-flowing stream
Let justice roll down like waters
Righteousness like a mighty stream

[Verse]
Seek good and not evil, that you may live
Hate evil and love good
Establish justice in the gate
Maybe the Lord will be gracious

[Chorus]
But let justice roll down like waters
And righteousness like an ever-flowing stream
Let justice roll down like waters
Righteousness like a mighty stream
